summary: Describes a non-standard but widely implemented change to how TCP handles ICMP soft errors: pending connection attempts are rejected when such errors arrive. This avoids long delays, for example for dual-stack hosts with IPv6 enabled in mostly IPv4 networks. This is an informational document.

eli5.summary: If you knock on a door and a sign says nobody lives here, give up quickly and try the next house. TCP tends to do that now.

questions: how does tcp react to icmp soft errors
